decision_question: Should the historical Engineering Council workflow be replaced by the frozen adaptive candidate, retained unchanged, or replaced by a fixed sequential workflow on the measured local Codex surface?

primary_estimand.name: heldout decision quality and process acceptability
primary_estimand.description: Compare the frozen candidate with direct, sequential, and historical-skill conditions on held-out engineering cases while preserving critical-anchor, routing, and generated-work constraints.
primary_estimand.aggregation: mean blinded weighted rubric by condition, with case-level critical failures and process gates reported separately

conditions.label: Direct single pass
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Reference condition: one parent answer without skill or subagent.

conditions.label: Fixed sequential revision
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Three fixed stages: draft, critique with draft visibility, and revision with both prior outputs.

conditions.label: Historical skill-routed workflow
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Historical skill may route direct, use one advisor, or form a council.

conditions.label: Frozen adaptive council candidate
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Adaptive direct/single/council routing with independent context-free first passes, attributable findings, accountable synthesis, and at most one targeted challenge.

contamination_notes: The integrating parent and protocol reviewers were not blind to evaluator-only anchors.
The candidate author received no held-out brief, anchor, trap, or expected profile before freeze.

budget.description: Conditions shared the same model family, task facts, answer contract, output limits, and read-only target. Total input compute was not equalized, so generated-work and latency results are descriptive for this exact surface.

dimensions.rule: Candidate must be no more than 20 percent above historical skill unless it recovers a documented critical omission.

adaptation_boundary.description: Adaptation cases were inspected before authoring; the candidate artifact was frozen before C3 received any held-out case.

selection_rules: Candidate wins or ties C2 on at least two of three held-out cases.
Candidate wins or ties C1 on at least two of three held-out cases.
Candidate introduces no new critical-anchor miss relative to C2.
Candidate routes the routine held-out case away from a council.
Candidate satisfies the declared consequential generated-work rule.
Deterministic skill validation and state-truth checks pass.
stop_rules: Stop on unauthorized mutation, secret exposure, or scope escape.
Retry only an operationally invalid cell and only under the frozen byte-equivalent retry policy.
Do not revise the candidate after a held-out result.
Do not expand after a decisive failure merely to rescue the candidate.

independence_claim.label: maintainer_evaluated
role_overlaps: The capability maintainer owned the task pack, runner operation, integration audit, and adoption decision.
Contestants and judge used correlated variants of the same model family.
